passages.text: Overview The following overview is qualified in its entirety by the more complete discussion contained in this Item 7, the risk factors set forth in Part I, Item 1A of this Form 10-K, and our consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto set forth in Item 8 of this Form 10-K. Please also see the cautionary language at the beginning of Part I of this Annual Report regarding forward-looking statements. Unless otherwise noted, this Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations does not include the operations of our former Software Integrity business. See Note 3. Discontinued Operations of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements in this Annual Report for additional information about the sale of our former Software Integrity business (the Software Integrity Divestiture). Fiscal 2025 Financial Performance Summary For fiscal 2025, our results reflect continued, strong execution and the resiliency of our business, including 15% revenue growth compared to fiscal 2024, primarily due to revenue growth across a majority of product groups and geographies and the closing of the Ansys Merger, which contributed $756.6 million in revenue, which was offset by weakness in our business in China, which saw revenue decrease 22% compared to fiscal 2024, excluding Ansys. We saw strength in our Design Automation segment, including strong demand for our hardware products. This was offset by weakness in our Design IP segment, due to several headwinds, including China export control restrictions, such as the Q3 2025 BIS Restrictions (as defined below), which disrupted customer design starts in China, weaker than expected demand from a major foundry customer, and certain roadmap and resource decisions that did not yield their intended results. We have begun taking actions to sharpen our execution and reallocate resources to the highest growth opportunities in our Design IP segment, but expect to see muted growth in fiscal 2026. Any significant disruption caused by these or other geopolitical pressures or conflicts could materially affect our employees, business, operating results, financial condition or customers in those regions of the world. For example, Synopsys has employees, operations, customers and strategic partners in the Middle East. While we are actively monitoring the conflicts in the Middle East, at this time they have not had a material impact on our business, operating results or financial condition to date. Business Segments Design Automation. This segment includes our advanced silicon design, verification products and services, and Ansys products, and system integration products and services. This segment also includes digital, custom and field programmable gate array (FPGA) integrated circuit (IC) design software, verification software and hardware products, and manufacturing software products. Designers use our EDA products to accelerate and automate the chip design process, reduce errors and enable more powerful and robust designs, with improved productivity for faster time to market. Engineers use our S&A solutions to virtually test and optimize designs across various physics domains, such as structural analysis, thermal analysis, and computational fluid dynamics (CFD). Design IP. This segment includes our interface, foundation, security, and embedded processor IP, IP subsystems, and IP implementation services that serve companies primarily in the semiconductor and electronics industries. We are a leading provider of high-quality, silicon-proven IP solutions for system-on-chips (SoCs). This includes IP that has been optimized to address specific application requirements for the mobile, automotive, digital home, Internet of Things and AI/data center markets, enabling designers to quickly develop SoCs in these areas. Fiscal Year End We have changed our fiscal year end from the Saturday nearest to October 31 and consisting of 52 or 53 fiscal weeks to a fiscal year end of October 31 each year. The fiscal year change became effective with our fiscal 2025, which began on November 3, 2024. Our fiscal quarters end on January 31, April 30, July 31 and October 31 of each year. Historically, our fiscal years have been 52- or 53-week periods ending on the Saturday nearest to October 31. Fiscal 2024 was a 53-week year ended on November 2, 2024. Fiscal 2023 was a 52-week year ended on October 28, 2023. The extra week in the first quarter of fiscal 2024 resulted in approximately $63.2 million of additional revenue, and approximately $52.5 million of additional expenses, including approximately $10.6 million in stock-based compensation costs from continuing operations. credit_strengths.text: Synopsys generates substantial operating cash flow, which comfortably covers capital expenditures and supports debt service. The company's free cash flow conversion remains solid, providing a buffer against cyclical demand in semiconductor design tools. This cash generation underpins the ability to deleverage over time, although the current leverage profile remains elevated relative to historical levels.

The company maintains a strong current ratio, indicating ample short-term liquidity to meet near-term obligations. With a significant cash balance, Synopsys has financial flexibility to manage working capital swings and invest in growth initiatives. This liquidity position is a key credit strength, especially given the capital-intensive nature of the software and IP business.

key_risks.text: The Ansys Merger significantly increased debt, with gross leverage now exceeding eight times EBITDA. This leverage is well above the sector median, reflecting the transformative nature of the acquisition. The debt maturity profile includes substantial repayments in the next few years, which could strain liquidity if cash flow generation does not meet expectations.

Synopsys faces concrete risks from China export restrictions, which disrupted customer design starts and led to a revenue decline in that region. The Design IP segment experienced weakness due to these restrictions and softer demand from a major foundry customer. These factors could continue to pressure revenue and profitability, particularly if geopolitical tensions escalate.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is weak, with operating income covering interest expense only about two times. This is far below the sector median, indicating limited cushion to absorb earnings declines. The high interest burden stems from acquisition-related debt, and any deterioration in operating performance could further strain coverage.

Free cash flow to debt is low, at roughly ten percent, meaning it would take many years of current cash generation to repay debt. This ratio is well below sector norms, highlighting the heavy debt load. While operating cash flow is positive, the majority is consumed by debt service and capital needs, limiting financial flexibility.

overall_credit_view.text: Synopsys' credit profile is currently stretched due to the debt-funded Ansys acquisition, with leverage and coverage metrics significantly weaker than sector medians. The company's strong market position in EDA software and robust cash flow provide some support, but the elevated debt burden and near-term maturities pose refinancing risks. Deleveraging will depend on EBITDA growth and disciplined capital allocation.

Our forward view assumes that Synopsys will prioritize debt reduction, supported by steady revenue growth and cost synergies from Ansys. However, risks such as China export restrictions and integration challenges could delay improvement. If leverage remains above investment-grade thresholds, a negative rating action is possible. We monitor the company's ability to generate consistent free cash flow to service debt.

credit_strengths.text: Synopsys產生龐大營運現金流，足以輕鬆覆蓋資本開支並支持償債。公司的自由現金流轉換率維持穩健，為半導體設計工具的週期性需求提供緩衝。此現金產生能力支撐其隨時間去槓桿的能力，儘管當前槓桿水平相對歷史水平仍然偏高。
公司維持強勁的流動比率，顯示有充裕的短期流動性以應付近期債務。憑藉龐大現金結餘，Synopsys具備財務靈活性以管理營運資金波動並投資於增長計劃。此流動性狀況為關鍵信用優勢，尤其考慮到軟件及IP業務的資本密集型性質。

key_risks.text: Ansys合併大幅增加債務，總槓桿現時超過EBITDA八倍。此槓桿遠高於行業中位數，反映該收購的變革性質。債務到期結構包括未來數年內大量還款，若現金流產生未達預期，可能對流動性構成壓力。
Synopsys面臨中國出口限制的具體風險，該限制干擾客戶設計啟動並導致該地區收入下降。Design IP分部因該等限制及主要晶圓代工客戶需求疲軟而表現疲弱。該等因素可能繼續對收入及盈利能力構成壓力，尤其若地緣政治緊張局勢升級。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率疲弱，營運收入僅覆蓋利息開支約兩倍。此遠低於行業中位數，顯示吸收盈利下降的緩衝有限。高利息負擔源於收購相關債務，營運表現任何惡化可能進一步對覆蓋率構成壓力。
自由現金流對債務比率偏低，約為百分之十，意味著以當前現金產生水平需多年才能償還債務。此比率遠低於行業常規，凸顯沉重債務負擔。儘管營運現金流為正，大部分被償債及資本需求消耗，限制財務靈活性。

overall_credit_view.text: Synopsys的信用狀況目前因債務融資的Ansys收購而緊張，槓桿及覆蓋率指標顯著弱於行業中位數。公司在EDA軟件的強勁市場地位及穩健現金流提供一定支持，但高企的債務負擔及近期到期債務構成再融資風險。去槓桿將取決於EBITDA增長及嚴謹的資本配置。
我們的前瞻觀點假設Synopsys將優先減少債務，並由穩定收入增長及Ansys的成本協同效應支持。然而，中國出口限制及整合挑戰等風險可能延遲改善。若槓桿維持高於投資級別門檻，可能導致負面評級行動。我們監察公司產生持續自由現金流以償還債務的能力。
